title: Steelers install new grass field at Acrisure Stadium after NFLPA survey graded previous surface poorly

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Steelers install new grass field at Acrisure Stadium after NFLPA survey graded previous surface poorly
sources.description: The previous field at Acrisure Stadium received an F-minus grade in the NFLPA report cards and was called "borderline unplayable" by Aaron Rodgers.
